g.title:
'$'''cat <<-'''EVAL_HEREDOC'''
{
 for i in {1..2}, do
 ( recursive_bg 2 ) &
 done
} | tee >(cat >&2) >/dev/null &
EVAL_HEREDOC
' (3,412 us, 0.06%)
'@TRAP (EXIT): echo "EXIT $depth"\, trap "echo NESTED_EXIT $depth" EXIT, @TRAP (RETURN): echo NESTED_RETURN 2' (60,903 us, 1.05%)

'$'''cat <<-'''NESTED'''
for ((i=0, i<2, i++)), do
 ( eval "echo NESTED-${depth}-\$i" ) &
done
wait
NESTED
' (1,094 us, 0.02%)
'@TRAP (EXIT): echo "EXIT $depth"\, trap "echo NESTED_EXIT $depth" EXIT, @TRAP (RETURN): echo NESTED_RETURN 3' (29,992 us, 0.52%)
'@TRAP (EXIT): echo "EXIT $depth"\, trap "echo NESTED_EXIT $depth" EXIT, @TRAP (RETURN): echo NESTED_RETURN 1' (30,096 us, 0.52%)

'$'''eval "$(cat <<-'''NESTED'''
for ((i=0, i<2, i++)), do
 ( eval "echo NESTED-${depth}-\$i" ) &
done
wait
NESTED
)"' (381 us, 0.01%)
